correctness.rationale: The exact combinatorial proof begins with GP(10,2), independently checks all 5,828 independent faces and mod-two boundary ranks 19,141,519,991,921,315,5, establishing mod-two reduced Betti numbers (0,0,0,0,0,4,0,0). The rational Betti numbers are bounded coefficientwise and the reduced Euler characteristic −4 forces only rational H_5 of dimension 4. The augmented signed Hopf trace formula is derived with the empty-face convention. All 120 graph automorphisms are exhaustively enumerated, orientation checked at each vertex, and exact signed Lefschetz traces agree with epsilon*(fixed maximum cocliques−1) on every element. Character equality gives the rational module by Maschke; no integral lattice is asserted. Actual packaged verifier and recorded output checked.

value.rationale: The canonical regular dodecahedron has full icosahedral symmetry, and its known four-sphere wedge type does not reveal which 4-dimensional representation is carried by rational homology. The exact orientation-twisted five-maximum-independent-set module identifies an irreducible A5 constituent, a sign reversal of the central antipode, a full 120-element character and vanishing invariants, providing an intrinsic equivariant classification rather than a routine Betti number recalc.
